product.title: Wired Stereo Earphones with Microphone – Clear Sound & Comfortable Fit
product.body_html:
Experience superior audio quality with these wired stereo earphones featuring a 3.5mm jack and built-in microphone. Designed for clear sound and all-day comfort, these earphones are ideal for smartphones, laptops, and audio devices.

Key features

  • High-quality stereo sound with powerful bass and crisp treble for immersive listening.
  • Universal 3.5mm jack compatible with most smartphones, laptops, tablets, and MP3 players.
  • Built-in microphone enables hands-free calling and voice assistant commands.
  • In-line button control for easy play, pause, and call management.
  • Soft silicone earbuds provide a secure and comfortable noise-isolating fit.
  • Tangle-free 1.2m durable cable enhances portability and everyday usability.
  • Lightweight and compact design perfect for travel, workouts, gaming, or long listening sessions.
  • Suitable for music, online meetings, gaming, and casual or professional use.

Materials & care

Made with durable plastic and soft silicone earbuds, these earphones require no special care other than gentle wiping to keep clean.

FAQ

Q1: Are these wired stereo earphones compatible with all devices?
A: Yes, they feature a universal 3.5mm jack compatible with most smartphones, laptops, tablets, and audio players.
Q2: Can I use the built-in microphone for online calls?
A: Absolutely, the inbuilt microphone supports clear hands-free calling and voice assistant use.
Q3: How long is the cable?
A: The earphones come with a 1.2-meter tangle-free cable for comfortable and portable use.
Q4: Are the earbuds comfortable for long use?
A: Yes, the soft silicone earbuds provide a secure and comfortable noise-isolating fit for extended wear.
Q5: Is there a button for music control?
A: Yes, an in-line button allows you to play, pause, and manage calls easily.
